chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Soponiias gu mar gu Kusi gu mar gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Amariias gu mar gu Esekîas gu tanoolh gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Amoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax; gio ba' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu Judaa bhaan bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem dhi' pai' gu Baal gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Kemarim bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨkka.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios mia'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu maa'nkar tu' koi'cham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan chiñia' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx tɨi'chu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan bɨx ki'ñgob iatda' gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dɨr ki'ñgob dɨr gookim jix gɨ' dɨr.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Maktes na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx tuumiñ.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' kutun kavɨk gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook tu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu' cham jix daa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' mia'n gu tanoolh jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios mia'n gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh daak mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu jodai' na jix uam gu tanoolh gu tukgam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bhaan gɨ' vaak.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jiim na ja'p ñiññia na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't na ja'p oo' gu chuukug na ja'p.

Jano' ba' tu' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu tanoolh daak gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx gu oidha' ka't bɨɨx gu tai; na gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx bɨɨx bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam cham.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na ja'p; gio ba' va'k bhaan gu ñi'ook i'iich gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios va'k gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr boopoya' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu Gasa ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Askaloon; gio ba' gu Asdod tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Ekroon ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Keretim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Kanaan gu oidha' gu Palestinos tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' duu bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' bipia'dam kakneer.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr baasɨ'n na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Askaloon gu tukaa'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Moab ka't na ja'p gu Sodoma gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon na ja'p gu Gomorra; gio ba' yooxi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' dhi' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios bhaan na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'; gio ba' maa'n dɨr pai' bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Etiopiia boopoya' koko'kam bɨɨx gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Assur gu Niinibe na ja'p oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax jix duu bɨx gu vaakax chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gio; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't kiki'ñgob na gu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' kiicham jix bhai'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨtda gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu vaakax gu Kualkuiera ju'ñdharan jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' sɨsɨɨ' gu xumai cham o'o na ba' gu xibh.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan xidhuu ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu xibh gu tasi' ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham pai' dhuuk uañi'ñ; gu' jix bhai'x cham juraa'n xi'ɨraam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm cham; jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm cham gu chio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jum i'obh makia' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham ka't ba'bhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan; gu' jix búup gu xibh bɨx buimɨi.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh; na gu' gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx i'iich gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tai ka't bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' na ba' bɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu Etiopiia mar u'vɨ gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham ka' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matgɨm buimɨi bɨɨx tu' bhaan tu'; na gu' jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam gampai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel cham tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu chin gu ñi'ook nɨɨn gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; na gu' ka't cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu i'ii'ñ mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' baas mai' obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham jum i'obh; mi' dhɨr gu Sioon cham gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨda'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook xoi'kam jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu; na ba' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx; gio ba' dodhia'; mi' dhɨr bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' bɨx gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' bhai' ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
